result.title: An Image Detectability Field as a Viewpoint Utility for 2D-3D Localization in Sparse Maps
result.summary: In 2D-3D localization, a camera estimates its pose by matching an image to a 3D map. A camera held in a hand or mounted on a robot can often choose its viewpoint before it takes the image. In this work, we ask whether an image detectability field is a useful viewpoint utility when the planner reads only the geometry of the map. The field can be queried at any 3D point near a surface. From the local geometry around the point, it predicts how likely a 2D image detector is to fire at the projection of the point. We use the trained field as it is, without fine-tuning it for view selection. A fixed SuperPoint and EPnP-RANSAC localizer then estimates the pose from the chosen view. We answer in two settings, each with a test registered before the runs. On synthetic ShapeNet objects with sparse point maps, summing the field over the visible landmarks beats counting them by +2.0 points of localization success rate (object-clustered 95% interval [+0.7, +3.2]). It also beats summing Harris-3D ranks by +2.2 [+0.8, +3.5]. On real indoor scenes from SceneFun3D, our adaptation of the learned view scorer LWL falls below counting on the test rooms. We therefore add the field to a learned per-landmark planner. On the test rooms with sparse maps whose landmarks the field also selects, the planner with the field beats the same planner without it by +1.8 points. It beats the planner with Harris-3D or curvature in its place by +1.0 and +0.8 points. All three room-clustered intervals lie above zero. In both settings, the field helps in sparse maps and is on par with Harris-3D in dense maps.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究2D-3D定位中手持或机器人相机在拍摄前的视角选择问题，提出可由地图局部几何在任意近表面3D点查询的「图像可检测性场」，用它预测2D检测器在该点投影处响应的概率，并将其作为视角效用，配合固定的SuperPoint与EPnP-RANSAC定位器，在合成ShapeNet与真实SceneFun3D稀疏地图上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 该场把「某视角能提供多少可检测证据」量化为可预先查询的效用，与LVR中视觉证据筛选及主动选择观测的可能联系值得核查；但论文不涉及latent推理状态或VLM，仅是概念与效用设计上的启发线索。
